gen-audiowide-gf-geom: Geom brings a lofty lowercase and a friendly, contemporary feel to the text. And Audiowide, with crossbars as fat as its stems, gives the heading a techy punch that the plain sans lets breathe.
gen-audiowide-gf-hammersmith-one: Tile-like glyphs with wide gaps and no thick-thin shift give Audiowide its futuristic look, while Hammersmith One's rounded strokes, like cut cord, stay clean beneath. Shrink the heading and that edge fades.
gen-audiowide-gf-inder: Audiowide draws every glyph with one unmodulated line, tall in the lowercase and spaced like tiles. Inder, a clean sans with little gap between its cases, keeps paragraphs smooth.
gen-audiowide-gf-jaldi: Approachable is the first word for Jaldi, with its tall x-height and gaping c, brushed on tight. And Audiowide's curves, which lack any stress, add a techy gleam above it, while paragraphs stay easy.
gen-audiowide-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Audiowide has no hairlines and no swells anywhere, just tile-spaced letters with a futuristic, tech edge. Kdam Thmor Pro fills its lines with bowls, so it handles the text.
gen-audiowide-gf-krona-one: Wire-thin lines, tech-minded. Audiowide sets that tone, and Krona One, a loosely spaced sans with lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals, carries the text with approachable weight.
gen-audiowide-gf-magra: Magra reads big-bodied in every lowercase word, a professional plain sans with no fuss. Audiowide handles the futuristic flourish, with a y whose tail matches its arm, and Magra the steady text.
gen-audiowide-gf-major-mono-display: Precise is the word for Major Mono Display, with neon-glass tubes. Audiowide brings its futuristic, tile-spaced letters on top, so the monospace body glows quietly beneath a heading with a single unmodulated line.
gen-audiowide-gf-martian-mono: Futuristic type meets code-style type. The pair's strongest quality is structure: Audiowide's tile-like glyphs sit over Martian Mono, a monospace with fixed-width, far-apart letters and generous openings.
gen-audiowide-gf-matemasie: Techy tiles over tidy text. Audiowide's tall lowercase and wide gaps lead, and Matemasie, a sans with broad glyph gaps and small entry points, keeps a long passage moving cleanly.
